title: comptime evaluation cannot observe mutable host state: the globalThis binding is unreachable
notes: specification/comptime.mdx, 'Determinism': comptime 'MUST NOT observe ambient ... mutable host state'. `globalThis` is the whole mutable host namespace in one binding — every property on it can be written by any code in the process — so a comptime read of it is a read of mutable host state whatever member it goes on to select.
